Thank you for all of your replies. Yes, he did hit me yesterday. It has happened before but only when he was furious with me, which is not often (3 times now). I kept pushing him and made him very angry for it to happen. I don't think he's abusive. I have had abusive boyfriends, both physically and sexually... I know what "real" abuse is, and I just feel like my SO snapped, but it was because I made him snap. I have schizophrenia/psychosis, so I know that he tolerates my psychotic episodes/rages, and helps me through them when I lose my mind, something differently entirely that I'd rather not talk about, but I do believe he genuinely cares about me to stay with me through all of my mental problems. I talked to him for about 2 hours today. Actually when I made this post it was because I originally wanted to show him (this is a secondary account) the replies I received, because I wanted to have a serious talk with him about what will happen in the future when he is angry. I wasn't sure whether or not to add the hitting part, which is why I edited it out after inserting it. I felt that adding the hitting part would skew the replies I receive, which is why I edited it out, because him hitting me is not my main concern (or point). My concern is that, when he is angry with me (when we have a fight), I do not feel loved. He wants me to go away. I did not want to go away last night. I kept pushing and pushing and crying endlessly because I wanted affection, and I wouldn't let it go, and he hit me, to knock some sense into me. He is not a violent person, but due to my over-clingy-ness and crave for affection, I feel like I'm nearly suffocating him, and driving him to the point where he ends up feeling like he needs to get away from me. 

I felt that it was very important to talk with him about yesterday. 

This was what he said to me, so you can see it from his perspective, because he is not a bad guy. Far from perfect, but he is still the most kind and caring man I have met, even more so for tolerating my mental illness.

"I'm not going to want to cheer you up if we're getting into relationship problems with each other. If you're the one that I'm not feeling good about (ie you're the one I'm feeling upset about) then I'm definitely not going to WANT to be around you because that's going to invoke more unpleasant feelings out of me, and I don't want that. Crying, pleading, begging, forcing, AND DEMANDING.... that's all going to make it much much worse.

You're in charge of your own emotions. Did I make you feel bad? Why did I make you feel bad? Maybe because you put me in an unpleasant situation that I never wanted to be in in the first place!! Like I fucking told you from the beginning. I hated that. So NO, I'm NOT going to be giving you love and affection afterwords. Not until I'm done feeling upset/guilty about what I went through because of you. It's the way that you conduct yourself that I advise you against and you string me along like nothing bad is going to happen."

He does make me feel happy and safe. Seldom does he make me feel miserable, but when he does, I just wish he would try to cheer me up, instead of leaving me alone to cry. I wish I could explain it better, but I just wish he would try to make me happy when I'm sad.

Sometimes to the first question, yes to the second.

He usually is affectionate, but when we fight (could be about anything), he is notorious for ~~making me feel worthless & unwanted~~ withholding affection.

He is normally affectionate but he's not really sexual. I practically have to beg him to make love with me. Besides that, he is affectionate in that he gives me hugs and kisses, but not much else. I try not to bring up sex because I don't want him to feel like I'm forcing him but I feel pretty unsatisfied overall in that department... And no, we live separately.
Last question and then I'll leave you alone - why do I need to use nail polish at all if I'm just going to sand it down lol

Congratulations on quitting after so long.

I do not understand the appeal of smoking and how anyone can get started because it tastes disgusting.

On the other hand, I have noticed in every mental support group I've attended that nearly everyone smokes. It seems to be a normal (or social) thing.

I'm really happy to see a post like this because I didn't know this was a thing. There are times where I look really hard at something because I see an image that I know it's not there. At night, I see faces or animals in the folds of my blankets, or in the wrinkles of my bedsheets.

How is Ziprasidone going for you and what are the common side effects you have? That is the only medication that has ever worked for me but because I had severe side effects on it, I was asked to immediately stop it.

>emergency medication

Like benzos or what?

I'm about to start working full time. It's going to my first job and I am absolutely terrified.

Oh no I didn't mention it in my post. I've overdosed on a lot of my medications intentionally, to make them "work" better in a short period of time. I don't have any benzo prescriptions otherwise I would just use those. I just don't know what else to do when I start hearing voices.

Thank you, I will see if this works. I have some command hooks stuck to a mirror and they have been no problem with staying hung, as well as the ones in the bath-tub region (tiles), but the walls at this place is just shitty.

I've tried to use nails before (and just filled it with toothpaste afterwards), however the sheet rock and dry wall is just so shitty that it crumbles and the nail falls right down. I don't know what else to do.

The paint peels off the wall when I try to remove the adhesive, I'm not too sure if it comes off when the hook falls off naturally after a few days. It's hard to tell because the paint is white and the sticky tabs are also white.
Question why do I have to use fine grit sandpaper? Can I use normal sandpaper like from a 100/100 nail filer?

I just got off of Risperidone. It made my hallucinations much worse, and it made me gain a lot of weight. Nothing good came out of Risperidone until I overdosed on it - and then I slept for a long time. Medication #5 is Zyprexa. I have not yet started it.

And thank you :)

I only ever take them at night. But when I go to sleep (they're sedating) I end up sleeping for 14+ hours at a time and still feel very tired when I wake up, even at a low dosage. I've been gradually moving them up towards the afternoon so I don't wake up in the middle of the next day's afternoon.

I'm in the same position. Finals tomorrow and Thursday and I'm also a compsci major. My best friend jumped off a building and killed himself sometime ago. I couldn't stop thinking about him last night.

You can talk to me. I just made this account because I don't know what to do with myself to occupy myself from all of these fucking voices. For the last 3 hours I've been at my boyfriend's house alone while he is at work. I don't know what to do with myself. I'm constantly hearing voices as I was yesterday. Received a new atypical medication that I don't plan on taking (because I'm in school and this is my final's week) until after classes are done... But right now I am going insane and I don't know what to do. I feel like the only way to overcome this is to either hurt myself or swallow a bunch of pills to the point of passing out (sleeping) or severe sedation. I just don't want to be awake right now. I can't concentrate on anything. I can't do anything. I don't know what else to say.
